CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c ), NULL, IF( OR( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c < 0, TLG_Social_Security_Number__c > 999999999 ), TEXT( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c ), LPAD( TEXT( FLOOR( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c / 1000000 ) ), 3, "0" ) & "-" & LPAD( TEXT( FLOOR( MOD( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c, 1000000 ) / 10000 ) ), 2, "0" ) & "-" & LPAD( TEXT( MOD( TLG_Social_Security_Number__c, 10000 ) ), 4, "0" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Social Security #
